k: Shadow runs on its own. In classic mode with a fresh graph, every review also builds the card silently and records its stats. Reviews are unchanged. Check the rehearsal. After a few rounds, run ist reviews cost. The fallback share should be low (under 20%). Persistent fallbacks also show up in ist doctor and the feed. Switch the repo.
